title: ChemInform Abstract: Natural Products as Templates for Bioactive Compound Libraries. Part 3. Novel Heterocycles and Peptidomimetics Generated from Anabasine by Isocyanide‐Based Multicomponent Reactions.
abstract: AbstractTwo series of novel drug‐like alkaloid derivatives are synthesized starting from natural anabasine (I) using prominent isocyanide‐based multicomponent processes.
